column1: CHANGELOG - Unaware in The City 2: Revisited
GENERAL:
A lot of changes, tweaks and fixes everywhere — only the notable ones (that I didn't forget to list) are listed below.
BUG FIXES:
Fixed many bugs & issues everywhere.
Multiple Android fixes related to incompatible PC settings being used.
Jane no longer follows Albert into Old Town and gets stuck there.
Fixed Primary Needs (sleep/showering/peeing).
MAJOR FEATURES:
Added Albert Rent Mini-Game — Seduction (undressing) and Not Paying (undressing + touching).
Added the Trespassing system — Jane can now break into locations.
ART & ANIMATION:
Updated character art & shaders.
Updated background art in Home, Block & Diner (Wall & Ground tiles). Still WIP.
Added or updated multiple animations.
Added lights & shadows (Experimental).
Added item & skill icons.
CHARACTER CREATION:
Added 2 sliders for quick height & width editing of the character's body.
Each backstory now has different starting Health & Sanity, among other changes.
Remade preset saving — players can now choose what gets saved/loaded.
SKILLS, PERKS, TRAITS & BUFFS:
Added Abilities.
Added buff system with all kinds of functionality (stacking, refreshing, etc.).
All Skills unified into 4 ranks; buffs allow scaling up to rank 6.
Traits and Perks can now be filtered (search, dropdown, etc.).
Simplified the perk cost formula to make it easier to understand.
NPCs:
Renamed 'NPCs' to 'people' (etc.) in many places across the game.
NPCs can now follow Jane through the rooms.
NPCs won't talk to Jane if their Hostility is too high.
Updated NPC schedule system.
MINI-GAMES:
Expanded and improved the home masturbation mini-game (Bed only). Still WIP.
Temporarily disabled toilet & shower masturbation while the anims are being remade.
Some tweaks to the bubbles skill check mini-game.
GAMEPLAY & SYSTEMS:
Added a skippable introduction.
Improved player movement with mouse & touchscreen.
Multiple small details, e.g. Jane can get sick from overeating.
Tutorials are no longer disabled by default; also added a few more.
SAVING, LOADING & SETTINGS:
All game settings are now saved and loaded on game start.
Improved compatibility of the saving/loading feature — instead of breaking everything, it now tries to skip broken entries or revert to defaults.
Save/Load window now displays a warning about incompatibility.
After changing resolution, a 15-second pop-up asks whether to keep it before reverting automatically.
MAIN MENU:
Added News & Changelog sections.
Updated the main menu and added a very simple background animation.
Added social media buttons to the main menu.
UI & HUD:
Multiple improvements to UI & HUD.
Multiple changes and fixes to quote, chat bubble and floating text systems.
Clicking anywhere on screen with a mouse click now skips dialogues by default (can be changed).
Multiple changes and tweaks to ordering food.
Dialogue Window and some UI elements are now bigger on Android.
Initial tech demo release.
